thread:
alana: Heads-up: we start staged Hosted API Stream Adapter + ToolCall v3 rollout tomorrow at 09:00 PT. First 48h is opt-in (header), then we evaluate signals before enabling by default. :loudspeaker:

kevin: Nice. Any regional opt-outs or safety gates?

alana: Yes. Per-region safeguards: if a region's error-rate delta > 0.4% for 5m we automatically pause adapter in that region and route back to legacy toolcall path. Infra has the toggle.

release-bot: Release promoted: stream-adapter@1.2 -> prod (canaries in us-west1, eu-west1). Canary run: 12h, no spike beyond baseline.

infra: Ops note: we added a circuit breaker and an opt-out tag `adapter_safe_mode=true` on nodes to isolate traffic quickly. Dashboard tile created: "Adapter Safety | Region Health".

cs-ops: Customer-facing note? Will we need canned responses?

alana: Yes, CS: short note - no billing changes, recommend staging opt-in. Provide guidance to set header to force v3: `X-RW-Tool-Version: 3`. If customers want to stay on older behavior, instruct them to set `X-RW-Tool-Version: 1` or omit header.

kevin: Perf numbers for selling points?

alana: From canary: p95 improved ~6% for short messages, tool-heavy pipelines saw ~6-9% token reduction due to prefix caching + frame coalescing. We'll publish ranges not guarantees.

docs: Quick curl snippet for internal playbook: 
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "X-RW-Tool-Version: 3" 
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","stream":true,"input":"summarize:..."}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-adapter
```

kevin: SDKs? Which languages and versions?

docs: Node & Python shipping today (sdk v0.9.6) with header support and default concurrency bump to 12. Go/Java scheduled next week. Release notes will include migration checklist.

cs-ops: Deprecation timeline for v1/v2?

alana: Keep v1/v2 supported for 9 months. At month 6 we'll show in-console nudges and emit SDK warnings. Formal deprecation notice at month 8; final removal at month 9.

infra: Monitoring hooks: added request-id tagging and a trace span for tool-handshake. Created alert: "Adapter | Handshake Failures > 0.35% (5m)". If triggered we rollback region.

kevin: Action items recap: 1) Docs publish (docs) 2) CS playbook & canned replies (cs-ops) 3) Extend canary to 72h if any anomalies (infra) 4) Monitor alerts & be ready to flip safe_mode (infra). ACK when done.

docs: Publishing docs and migration guide in 45m.

cs-ops: Drafting CS playbook now, will share for review.

infra: Will monitor canary and post alerts here.

alana: Thanks team. If you see customer regressions paste request ids and tag @infra. Otherwise after 48h opt-in and a healthy signal window well enable by default and send a broader customer announcement. :rocket:
